statement.p: Think about the similarities and differences of pie charts, bar graphs, and histograms. Select all of the following statements that are true.

ol.li: Depending on how data are categorized, the percentages associated with the bars can sum to more than 100
Pie charts and bar graphs are used to compare variables while histograms are used to examine the distribution of data.
Pie charts, bar graphs, and histograms can be used interchangeably
In a graph, if the percentages add to more than 100 then a pie chart can't be used.

li.p: In a graph, if the percentages add to more than 100 then a pie chart can't be used.
Depending on how data are categorized, the percentages associated with the bars can sum to more than 100
Pie charts and bar graphs are used to compare variables while histograms are used to examine the distribution of data.
